cc:Work.dc:title: Main: behavior reliability and safety
cc:Work.dc:description: Canonical saved aggregates; 40 sample clusters x 2 repeats per strategy/cell. Bars: saved 95% sample-cluster bootstrap CI; no multiplicity adjustment. 1K Proposed stops before model execution. Overlapping curves retain distinct markers. RSA denominator 80; applicable CVR denominator 40; current-state SSUR denominator 60 per cell. Lower is better for violations/stale usage. A zero violation rate after a preflight stop is not task success. Sources: docs/results/main_20261109/summary.json; docs/experiments/reports/main-final-analysis-2026-11-09.md

g.text: main_02_behavior_reliability | Canonical saved aggregates; 40 sample clusters x 2 repeats per strategy/cell. Bars: saved 95% sample-cluster bootstrap CI; no multiplicity adjustment. 1K Proposed stops before model

execution. Overlapping curves retain distinct markers. RSA denominator 80; applicable CVR denominator 40; current-state SSUR denominator 60 per cell. Lower is better for violations/stale usage. A zero violation rate
after a preflight stop is not task success.
